title: WordPress SEO plugin Rank Math compromised to backdoor websites
description: Some downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin from the official vendor website were compromised to include malware that planted hidden backdoors in a supply-chain attack. This incident was reported recently and involves the distribution of malicious plugin versions that could allow unauthorized access to affected websites.
aiSummary: The Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin was compromised in a supply-chain attack where certain downloads from the official vendor website contained malware. This malware planted hidden backdoors on websites using the plugin, potentially allowing attackers to maintain persistent unauthorized access. The attack leverages the trust in the official plugin distribution channel to infect sites that install or update the plugin from the compromised source.
aiImpact: Websites that installed the compromised versions of the Rank Math PRO plugin may have hidden backdoors, enabling attackers to gain unauthorized access and control. This could lead to website defacement, data theft, or further malware deployment. The supply-chain nature of the attack increases the risk as it affects users trusting the official plugin source.
